digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause ownership
propositions: Bridge execution must be portable across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python entrypoint without requiring repository-local runner scripts
Legacy reconcile workflows and checked-out invocations of `rebar reconcile --mode ...` must retain existing behavior, defaults, exit codes, and messages without breaking changes
Provider-neutral destructive-repair schedule safety must be owned by `_repair_pause.py` using git-based durable pause mechanism (refs/reconciler/gate) with no GitHub CLI dependency
Local and CI provider execution routes must converge on exactly `rebar bridge run` as the unified entry point through the packaged core
Repair pause ownership must implement per-invocation identity tokens, foreign-pause abort semantics, and operator-only recovery without automatic retry reclaim
No new network-accessible or lower-trust-actor reachable surfaces are introduced; the refactoring preserves existing authentication and authorization boundaries
